mathematical_assessments.claim: Actual Gaussian fourth moment and Markov tail
mathematical_assessments.assessment: Gaussian fourth moment is derived by differentiating exp(v*t^2/2) four times and the existing MGF-to-moment identity. Integrability is obtained from the actual increment Gaussian law. Markov inequality is applied to a nonnegative integrable fourth power with r>0; finite source measure permits measureReal/ENNReal transport. No desired moment or tail certificate is a premise.

Grid spacing is 32^(-n); edge threshold is 2^(-n). The exact edge tail bound is 3*64^(-n); the finite union has N*32^n+1 edges and is bounded by 3*(N+1)*2^(-n). That geometric series is summable for each natural compact horizon. No independence is needed for this Borel-Cantelli direction.

Good quantifies only natural horizons N and eventual natural grid levels n. The event is explicitly proved measurable by countable unions/intersections of finite-edge events; good_ae uses ae_all_iff only over N:Nat. There is no uncountable intersection over real times.

mathematical_assessments.claim: Deterministic refinement estimates and Cauchy convergence
mathematical_assessments.assessment: The 32-grid refinement index difference is less than32. Adjacent-edge chain estimates give dist(step_n,step_(n+1)) <=16*2^(-n) eventually, with a compact horizon containing the fixed time. Summability implies Cauchy convergence in real completeness. All bounds are source-free deterministic consequences of Good, not assumed path regularity.

mathematical_assessments.claim: One measurable version with legitimate fallback
mathematical_assessments.assessment: process t omega is the countable grid limit on the SAME Good event for every t, and zero off Good. Existing StronglyMeasurable.limUnder on complete real target gives fixed-time measurable total limit including nonconvergent branches; measurable Good and the common zero fallback preserve measurability. It is not a time-indexed choice of unrelated a.e. versions.

Geometric tail bound dist(step_n,process)<=32*2^(-n) is uniform over each compact horizon after a common level. Nearby times within32^(-n) have floor indices differing by at most1, giving step oscillation <=2^(-n). The two tails plus oscillation are bounded by65*2^(-n), tending to0. Boundary t=0 and compact-neighborhood coverage are handled in NNReal. Outside Good the entire path is zero. This proves continuity for EVERY constructed path, without asserting raw coordinate paths are a.e. continuous.

mathematical_assessments.claim: Per-fixed-time modification of the same canonical coordinates
mathematical_assessments.assessment: Floor-grid time converges to t. Actual Gaussian second moment yields a Markov bound for step_n(t)-raw_B_t and convergence in probability. A.e. grid convergence on Good gives convergence in probability to process_t. Existing uniqueness of limits in measure yields process_t=raw_B_t a.e. for EACH FIXED t. The quantifier is forall t, ae omega, not ae omega, forall t.

mathematical_assessments.claim: Finite laws, Brownian realization and joint measurability
mathematical_assessments.assessment: IsPreBrownianReal.congr transfers the original finite-dimensional Gaussian laws using only the finitely many coordinates of each Finset; the pinned API uses ae_all_iff over that finite subtype. process_isBrownian adds proved all-path continuity. Native Caratheodory measurable_uncurry_of_continuous_of_measurable applies to NNReal time and real values using already proved fixed-time measurability and path continuity; it has no Brownian or continuity oracle premise.

mathematical_assessments.claim: Same-source nondegeneracy and original OU consumers
mathematical_assessments.assessment: process zero is a.e. zero and its variance at time1 is1, from the transferred source laws. Every OU endpoint keeps EXACT BrownianProjectiveSource.sourceLaw on raw canonical sample space and only replaces its coordinate readout with process. The original OU continuity theorem is supplied actual process_isBrownian; positive variance uses k>0, s!=0, t>0 and permits any deterministic x0. At each real t, ou_law_eq_canonical uses the fixed-time modification at the same deterministic OU clock, so it preserves the original marginal measure. Recovery is transported by this exact law equality and retains k>0 and 0<=T.

reuse_assessment: Reuses original Gaussian law/MGF differentiation, first Borel-Cantelli, real Cauchy/geometric limits, measurable total limUnder, convergence-in-measure uniqueness, finite-law congruence and native Caratheodory measurability. No assumed Kolmogorov continuity theorem, continuity certificate or hidden source premise. The new deterministic grid argument fills the actual missing continuous-version construction.
boundaries: Raw canonical coordinate paths are not asserted a.e. continuous. The result is a continuous modification on the same source probability space.
The construction is noncomputable mathematical realization, not an executable numerical sampler or discretization-error algorithm.
OU law equality is stated at each deterministic time and does not itself establish a full conditional Markov transition/semigroup, filtration, adaptedness or pathwise SDE bridge.
OU continuity holds for all declared parameters as a statement about the defined time-change family; recovery and strict noise variance correctly require k>0, with s!=0 and t>0 for strict variance.
No general stochastic integration, Ito, Girsanov, SDE/control/HJB, or cross-source one-World closure is claimed. Those remain separate obligations.
No original sampling record, failure record, risk threshold, action privilege, QM/physics, GI implementation or global configuration was changed.
